meta.policy: Only venue-controlled pages and official PDFs substantiate values. Unknown values are blank and flagged. A guarantee is not a forecast of actual payouts. Ratio = guaranteed pool ÷ buy-in, descriptive only.
meta.formula: Trip cost = entries × buy-ins + nights × true hotel cost; true nightly = rate + resort fee + 13.38% tax (tax applies to rate and resort fee per Bellagio terms; Venetian terms state 13.38% Clark County room tax and 'plus applicable tax' on the fee).
